claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Repaglinide is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM; its annotated targets (KATP channel subunits ABCC8/KCNJ11 and PPARG) are not cytotoxic in most cancer cell lines, and no off-target cytotoxic mechanism is evident at this concentration.
